Review Text: Maui Plane Rides surpassed our expectations. From the moment our pilot met us at our vehicle, we were his top priority and felt taken care of. We would absolutely recommend this adventure to others to try!

Review Text: "Awesome" is an overused word, but this trip did inspire awe. Our sunset flight around Maui was worth every penny.
